1.title: Iran faces 'economic D-Day', US treasury secretary warns
1.summary: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.

2.title: Nearly 90,000 told to evacuate as wildfire approaches Reno, Nevada
2.summary: The fire has burned around 10,500 acres and is completely uncontained, officials say.

3.title: 'Half my business will be gone' - Firms in Canada and US fear trade war
3.summary: Business owners in both countries are navigating uncertainty and worry as the tit-for-tat import taxes ratchet up.

4.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham Arrives in Ukraine as Russia Amps Up Warnings
4.summary: In his first foreign trip since taking office, Prime Minister Andy Burnham affirmed support for Kyiv despite new warnings from Moscow of consequences for doing so.

5.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
5.summary: Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.

6.title: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
6.summary: Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration appear to be continuing.
